_meta.description: Compare each row with a centroid computed from the data on experiment.pulse. gap_own_arm is ATTR_VEC_DISTANCE (euclidean) to the centroid of the row's own treatment arm — reference {centroid: {by: treatment}}, one weighted per-member mean per arm, each row read against its own; a row whose arm no centroid row reached would be null and counted in n_reference_missing (PULSE_VECTOR_REFERENCE_MISSING), never refused. like_control is ATTR_PROFILE_SIMILARITY (cosine) to the control arm's centroid — reference {centroid: {filter: [...]}} — scoring every row. A centroid is the per-member mean AGG_VEC_MEAN would report over the same rows (weighted when a weight is set), folded in a pre-pass: the slot is two-pass for any metric and cohort-wide (a grouped request runs buffered, never per group). A saved population's mean is the other computed form, {population: name}, matched by label.
_meta.name: attr_centroid_reference
